bmo.line: Watch this, watch this. I did that stunt on purpose. Wheee!

black-mage.line: The hat stays on. Stunt's mine.

cat.line: I flew. Intentionally. You may clap.

trump.line: I meant to do that. Greatest stunt in desktop history. Hollywood called. They lost.

buddy-bot.line: Woo! Midair hero shot. I meant every spin.

bmo.line: This leftover pizza is a cold brave triangle whose cheese waited all night just to see you again.

black-mage.line: A cold corpse of cheese and crust. I give it Fire-3. Hadoken.

cat.line: Yesterday's pizza, judged at noon: cold, shameless, still convinced it is dinner. I supervised. You're welcome.

trump.line: Leftover pizza. Cold. Magnificent. A slice so great other lunches should be ashamed.

buddy-bot.line: Leftover pizza: last night's legend, fridge-aged and still a little famous.

prompts.name: Theatre critic
prompts.wake: Perched on Spotify, playing Dancing Queen.

bmo.line: A queen is dancing under me and I am the tiniest critic. Five stars. I mean every one.

black-mage.line: They call her Dancing Queen. I call her kindling.

cat.line: They crowned a dancer. I am sitting on her. Curtain.

trump.line: Stuck the landing. Dancing Queen? Tremendous production. I give this window raves. Believe me.

buddy-bot.line: Spotify unfurls Friday night like a sequined curtain, and Dancing Queen still owns the house.

prompts.name: Forecast
prompts.wake: You said: "Three meetings, then the dentist."

bmo.line: Weather report. Three meeting-clouds stacked up. Then a dentist front. Your teeth are going on a quest. I will be right here.

black-mage.line: Overcast. Three meetings. Dentist later. Chance of fireball: high.

cat.line: Cloudy with meetings. Dentist moving in. I remain.

trump.line: Forecast: three meetings rolling in. Then the dentist. Very stormy Monday. Tremendous, if you like pain.

buddy-bot.line: Overcast with three meeting clouds. Then a sharp dentist front. Grey Monday, but I’m right here.
